notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
We have reworked the Game Over sequence and made the level select UI easier to navigate by selecting the next level to be played automatically instead of having to chose it from the list of levels. We also changed the game difficulty level after receiving comments that the game was too easy in the first levels. Lifes have been set at 5 instead of 10. After testing, we found that the game was more challenging with these settings. If you see any issues with this update, please let us know.

Thanks
Chris

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Hi,

In this update, all 30 levels of the game are now included. :-)
You will finally see and face Commander Bones! Good luck!
This will be the last update before the final release on august 28th. Lexie is finally complete. If you encounter any bugs with this version, please let us know so we can get them resolved before the full release. Basically, the game as it is now is completed so not much will change for the average gamer. What will change will be under the hood (performance tweeks, etc).

We hope you enjoy this final early release version. The next update will be the full release version.

Thanks
Chris

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hi,

All major bugs have been fixed! The game now plays very well and we are extremely happy about the results. You should not encounter any bugs but if you do, please report them in the community forum here on Steam. If you like the update, please give it a thumbs up!

Thank you
Chris

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hi,

Lexie has been updated to support keyboard and mouse input.
If you have any issues, please report them in the community forum.

Thank you

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Lexie has been updated to fix some bugs that were reported. Here is the list of what has been fixed:

- Keyboard and mouse no longer supported (must play with a controller)
- Pickup items bug fixed
- Settings menu now has resolution control and quality controls
- Leaderboard has been removed for now

Enjoy the update and let us know if you run into problems. If you find something, we will fix it in future updates. The full game is still on target to be fully released in August.

Thank you

notes.content:
